		st.mu.Unlock()

	}

		atomic.AddUint64(&DefaultSnmp.MuxStreamsClosed, 1)
	}
	st.mu.Unlock()
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)

	st.mu.Lock()
	st.remoteClosed = true
	if !st.closedCounted {

	}

	drained := len(st.recvBuf) == 0
	st.mu.Unlock()
'''

'''
